entry.title: Hello Graft 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: The reference graft: adds one marker attribute to the running brainstem and nothing else, so the conformance suite has something trivial to prove idempotence, safe mode and revert against. Requires the graft-engine pack.

entry.title: Graft Engine 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Discovers, applies and reports grafts - modules that patch the RUNNING brainstem without editing a byte of the grail. Adds the Grafts agent (status / apply / revert / log). Every other graft pack requires this one.

entry.title: GPT-6 Astra (Responses API) 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Makes gpt-6-astra a first-class model of the running brainstem: injects it into the live model picker and routes its requests to POST {endpoint}/responses, because Astra advertises no /chat/completions route. The grail's endpoint filter is left intact. Requires the graft-engine pack.

entry.title: Packs 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Install, update, pin, revert and remove brainstem packs from the signed rapp-packs channel — every byte verified before it is written.
